question: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH eligible_groups AS (
    SELECT
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        c.COURSE_LEVEL,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS unique_courses,
        MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units
    FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
    WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
      AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL
    HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10
)
SELECT
    eg.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    eg.COURSE_LEVEL,
    eg.unique_courses,
    eg.min_total_units
FROM eligible_groups eg
ORDER BY eg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eg.COURSE_LEVEL

FROM "SUBJECT_SUMMARY"
JOIN "COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED" ON "SUBJECT_SUMMARY"."DEPARTMENT_NAME" = "COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED"."DEPARTMENT_NAME"
JOIN "LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED" ON "COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED"."SUBJECT_ID" = "LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED"."SUBJECT_ID"

WITH eligible_groups AS (
    SELECT
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        c.COURSE_LEVEL,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS unique_courses,
        MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units
    FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
    WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
      AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL
    HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10
)
SELECT
    eg.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    eg.COURSE_LEVEL,
    eg.unique_courses,
    eg.min_total_units
FROM eligible_groups eg
ORDER BY eg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eg.COURSE_LEVEL
